title: New films appear on their own
description: Serves "New films just appear."; "Storage stays bounded.". How new films are found is the design's choice (D-125).
acceptanceCriteria: A film or episode added to local disk or to S3 is shown to viewers within a stated time, measured on both stores, with no action by the operator.
A renamed or moved file keeps its title and everyone's history (invariant 5).
Finding new films costs each store no more than a stated, measured number of requests per hour for a collection of stated size.
A removed file is hidden after the grace, as today (invariants 5 and 56).
